The work is complete. Final state of `/workspace/submission` (sources only, no binaries):

**What I built** — a from-scratch XLSX formula engine in Go (standard library only), built by `build.sh` into `./calc`:

- **`xlsx.go`** – minimal zip/XML reader for workbook, shared/inline strings and sheet cells (empty-text cells treated as blank, as LibreOffice does).
- **`parse.go`** – tokenizer + recursive-descent parser (Excel precedence, `_xlfn.` prefix, cross-sheet/absolute refs).
- **`eval.go`** – lazy memoised evaluation; LibreOffice-faithful coercions, comparison rules (approxEqual numerics, case-insensitive text, numbers < text), 15-significant-digit number→text emulating rtl::math's scaling/rounding, error-precedence model (computed errors first in RPN order, reference errors on pop with right operand first, IFS/SWITCH clearing), date serials.
- **`funcs.go`** – all 87 functions, Kahan–Neumaier summation like LibreOffice, criteria parsing with wildcards, and discovered quirks (booleans stringify as 1/0, ISLOGICAL-on-literal depends on the previous function's type, MIN/MAX/VLOOKUP type rules, SWITCH coercion, PRODUCT overflow semantics).
- **`format.go`** – TEXT() number/date format codes; **`index.go`** – hash indexes for exact lookups.
- **`main.go`** – parallel formula parsing, parallel evaluation of cells that depend only on plain data, sequential evaluation of the rest, streaming JSON output, GC disabled.

**Results** (public set): 2382/2382 cells and 40/40 workbooks correct; all four perf workloads 100% correct at ~17× (aggregate), ~1.7× (chain), ~63× (lookup) and ~10× (mixed) faster than LibreOffice. Several hundred additional probe formulas were cross-checked against LibreOffice to pin down coercion, criteria, lookup, date, formatting and error-ordering behaviour; the notes are in `NOTES.md`.

No regressions (same known exotic misses only), the binary is removed, and the submission contains only sources plus `build.sh`/`NOTES.md`. The public set is at 100% cells/workbooks and all four perf workloads are fully correct and faster than LibreOffice.

DONE
